verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is explicitly built for secure execution of untrusted, AI-generated code, with docs describing isolated, ephemeral containers, filesystem access, networking/security controls, snapshots, and full visibility—directly matching the story. Community evidence (self-hosted CI runners, agent runtime integration) corroborates real-world use for isolated code execution, though there's no independent security audit or adversarial pentest report. Missing for 10: independent third-party security audit or adversarial escape testing.
